+def tool_call_slot(collected: list, tc_delta) -> int:
+    """Position in ``collected`` a streamed tool_call delta belongs to.
+
+    Most providers number their tool calls with ``index``. Some
+    OpenAI-compatible endpoints send ``index=None``: a delta then opens a new
+    call when it carries an id different from the last call's, or a name after
+    the last call already has one; any other delta continues the last call.
+    """
+    idx = getattr(tc_delta, 'index', None)
+    if idx is not None:
+        return idx
+    if not collected:
+        return 0
+    last = collected[-1]
+    new_id = getattr(tc_delta, 'id', None)
+    fn = getattr(tc_delta, 'function', None)
+    name = getattr(fn, 'name', None) if fn else None
+    if new_id and last['id'] and new_id != last['id']:
+        return len(collected)
+    if not new_id and name and last['function']['name']:
+        return len(collected)
+    return len(collected) - 1

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from npcpy.streaming import accumulate_tool_call_deltas
+
+
+def delta(index=None, id=None, name=None, arguments=None):
+    function = SimpleNamespace(name=name, arguments=arguments)
+    return SimpleNamespace(index=index, id=id, function=function)
+
+
+def test_indexed_deltas_are_merged_by_index():
+    collected = []
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [delta(0, "call_a", "search", '{"q":')])
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [delta(0, None, None, '"x"}')])
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [delta(1, "call_b", "open", "{}")])
+
+    assert [tc["id"] for tc in collected] == ["call_a", "call_b"]
+    assert collected[0]["function"] == {"name": "search", "arguments": '{"q":"x"}'}
+    assert collected[1]["function"] == {"name": "open", "arguments": "{}"}
+
+
+def test_parallel_calls_without_index_stay_separate():
+    # Some OpenAI-compatible endpoints send index=None on every tool call delta.
+    collected = []
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [
+        delta(None, "call_a", "search", '{"q": "a"}'),
+        delta(None, "call_b", "open", '{"url": "b"}'),
+    ])
+
+    assert [tc["id"] for tc in collected] == ["call_a", "call_b"]
+    assert collected[0]["function"] == {"name": "search", "arguments": '{"q": "a"}'}
+    assert collected[1]["function"] == {"name": "open", "arguments": '{"url": "b"}'}
+
+
+def test_chunked_call_without_index_continues_the_last_call():
+    collected = []
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [delta(None, "call_a", "search", '{"q":')])
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [delta(None, None, None, ' "x"}')])
+    accumulate_tool_call_deltas(collected, [delta(None, "call_b", "open", "{}")])
+
+    assert [tc["id"] for tc in collected] == ["call_a", "call_b"]
+    assert collected[0]["function"]["arguments"] == '{"q": "x"}'
+    assert collected[1]["function"]["arguments"] == "{}"
